panels.prompt: Wide shot: giant figure crusted in white salt crystal, glowing blue eyes, chain whip, huge pick-hammer, roaring, salt dust shockwave; young witcher man, short ash-grey hair, golden cat eyes, half-asian face, stubble, dark leather armor, two swords on back frozen mid-stride, salt crystals locking boots.

Action shot: young chinese woman, long black braid, dark-blue outfit, glowing white bow looses rapid arrows of white light into salt dust shockwave, which shatters like glass, cracks of light spreading.

Action shot: shackle-link chain whip lashes shoulder of japanese teen boy, black hair, blue eyes, noble cloak, glowing golden sword, knocking him back, streak of blood; background right, blonde-braided axe woman hews chained salt-crusted convicts.

Low action shot: young witcher man, short ash-grey hair, golden cat eyes, half-asian face, stubble, dark leather armor, two swords on back beneath salt-crusted giant, two lightning-fast diagonal steel strokes along backs of its legs, crust chunks bursting.

Close shot: young witcher man, short ash-grey hair, golden cat eyes, half-asian face, stubble, dark leather armor, two swords on back presses bare palm to chest of salt-crusted giant with flickering blue eyes; behind his shoulder a faint tall smoke-like shadow. Cold blue.

Wide shot: huge pick-hammer smashes floor where young witcher man, short ash-grey hair, golden cat eyes, half-asian face, stubble, dark leather armor, two swords on back just stood, fan of salt shards; he rolls clear, sword in hand. Vaulted salt hall, cold blue.
